requirements.quote: The "QUIC Versions" registry governs a 32-bit space; see Section 15.
requirements.condition: When representing or processing a QUIC version codepoint.
requirements.required_behavior: Use a value from a 32-bit codepoint space.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not represent a QUIC version codepoint as wider than the defined 32-bit space.
requirements.why_checkable: The width and resulting numeric bounds of version codepoints can be checked in parsing, serialization, and internal representations.

requirements.quote:
The codepoint of 0x00000001 for the protocol is assigned with
   permanent status to the protocol defined in this document.  The
requirements.condition: When identifying the protocol version defined by RFC 9000.
requirements.why_checkable: Tests can verify that the implementation identifies and encodes the protocol defined by this document with the fixed 32-bit value 0x00000001.

requirements.quote:
codepoint of 0x00000000 is permanently reserved; the note for this
   codepoint indicates that this version is reserved for version
   negotiation.
requirements.condition: When processing or selecting QUIC version codepoint 0x00000000.
requirements.required_behavior: Treat 0x00000000 as reserved for version negotiation.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not treat 0x00000000 as an ordinary assigned protocol version.
requirements.why_checkable: An implementation can be tested to ensure that the fixed zero version value is recognized only in its reserved version-negotiation role.
